28:   nothing changes. `(release stock id)` makes a `:quarantined` lot `:active`
29:   again; anything else changes nothing.
30: - `(take-from stock id n now)` returns `[stock' ok?]`. When lot `id` is

(ns stock.core-test
  "Tests for stock.core: lots, usability, receiving, quarantine/release,
  taking and purging."
  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest testing is are]]
            [stock.core :as stock]))

;; --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

(defn lot
  "A lot map, :active unless a status is given."
  ([id sku qty expires] (lot id sku qty expires :active))
  ([id sku qty expires status]
   {:id id :sku sku :qty qty :expires expires :status status}))

(defn stock-of
  "A stock map built from a collection of lots and a next id."
  [lots next-id]
  {:lots (into {} (map (fn [l] [(:id l) l]) lots))
   :next-id next-id})

;; --- receive ---------------------------------------------------------------

(deftest receive-adds-an-active-lot
  (testing "a positive quantity adds an :active lot under :next-id"
    (let [[s id] (stock/receive (stock-of [] 7) 3 5 100)]
      (is (= 7 id))
      (is (= (stock-of [(lot 7 3 5 100)] 8) s)))))

(deftest receive-ids-increment
  (let [[s0 id0] (stock/receive (stock-of [] 0) 1 2 10)
        [s1 id1] (stock/receive s0 1 3 20)
        [s2 id2] (stock/receive s1 2 4 30)]
    (is (= [0 1 2] [id0 id1 id2]))
    (is (= 3 (:next-id s2)))
    (is (= (lot 0 1 2 10) (get-in s2 [:lots 0])))
    (is (= (lot 1 1 3 20) (get-in s2 [:lots 1])))
    (is (= (lot 2 2 4 30) (get-in s2 [:lots 2])))))

(deftest receive-keeps-existing-lots
  (let [before (stock-of [(lot 0 1 4 10)] 1)
        [s id] (stock/receive before 2 6 20)]
    (is (= 1 id))
    (is (= (lot 0 1 4 10) (get-in s [:lots 0])))
    (is (= (lot 1 2 6 20) (get-in s [:lots 1])))))

(deftest receive-zero-quantity-is-a-no-op
  (testing "empty stock"
    (let [before (stock-of [] 4)
          [s id] (stock/receive before 1 0 9)]
      (is (nil? id))
      (is (= before s))))
  (testing "stock with lots"
    (let [before (stock-of [(lot 0 1 4 10)] 1)
          [s id] (stock/receive before 1 0 9)]
      (is (nil? id))
      (is (= before s)))))

;; --- usable / available ----------------------------------------------------

(deftest available-sums-usable-lots
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)
                     (lot 2 1 3 20)
                     (lot 3 1 4 5)]
                    4)]
    (testing "all usable at now 0"
      (is (= 12 (stock/available s 1 0))))
    (testing "the lot expiring at 5 drops out at now 5"
      (is (= 8 (stock/available s 1 5))))
    (testing "a sku with no lots"
      (is (= 0 (stock/available s 9 0))))
    (testing "empty stock"
      (is (= 0 (stock/available (stock-of [] 0) 1 0))))))

(deftest available-excludes-unusable-lots
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)                 ;; usable
                     (lot 2 1 6 10 :quarantined)     ;; quarantined
                     (lot 3 1 0 10)                  ;; empty
                     (lot 4 2 7 10)]
                    5)]
    (is (= 5 (stock/available s 1 0)))
    (is (= 7 (stock/available s 2 0)))))

(deftest available-expiry-boundary
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 3 10)] 2)]
    (is (= 3 (stock/available s 1 9)) "now just before expiry")
    (is (= 0 (stock/available s 1 10)) "now at expiry")
    (is (= 0 (stock/available s 1 11)) "now past expiry")))

(deftest available-quantity-boundary
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 1 10) (lot 2 1 0 10)] 3)]
    (is (= 1 (stock/available s 1 0)) "qty 1 is usable, qty 0 is not")))

;; --- quarantine / release --------------------------------------------------

(deftest quarantine-marks-a-lot
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10) (lot 2 1 4 10)] 3)
        q (stock/quarantine s 1)]
    (is (= :quarantined (get-in q [:lots 1 :status])))
    (is (= :active (get-in q [:lots 2 :status])) "other lots untouched")
    (is (= 4 (stock/available q 1 0)) "quarantined lot is unusable")))

(deftest quarantine-missing-lot-changes-nothing
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)]
    (is (= s (stock/quarantine s 99)))))

(deftest quarantine-is-idempotent
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)
        q (stock/quarantine s 1)]
    (is (= q (stock/quarantine q 1)))))

(deftest release-reactivates-a-quarantined-lot
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10) (lot 2 1 4 10)] 3)
        q (stock/quarantine s 1)
        r (stock/release q 1)]
    (is (= :active (get-in r [:lots 1 :status])))
    (is (= 9 (stock/available r 1 0)))))

(deftest release-of-active-or-missing-changes-nothing
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)]
    (testing "an active lot stays active"
      (is (= s (stock/release s 1))))
    (testing "a missing lot changes nothing"
      (is (= s (stock/release s 99))))))

;; --- take-from -------------------------------------------------------------

(deftest take-from-partial-reduces-qty
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)
        [s' ok] (stock/take-from s 1 2 0)]
    (is (true? ok))
    (is (= 3 (get-in s' [:lots 1 :qty])))
    (is (= 2 (:next-id s')) "next-id is untouched")
    (is (= 5 (get-in s [:lots 1 :qty])) "the original stock is unchanged")))

(deftest take-from-one-is-allowed
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)
        [s' ok] (stock/take-from s 1 1 0)]
    (is (true? ok))
    (is (= 4 (get-in s' [:lots 1 :qty])))))

(deftest take-from-everything-removes-the-lot
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10) (lot 2 1 7 20)] 3)
        [s' ok] (stock/take-from s 1 5 0)]
    (is (true? ok))
    (is (not (contains? (:lots s') 1)) "a lot at qty 0 is removed")
    (is (= 7 (get-in s' [:lots 2 :qty])) "other lots untouched")
    (is (= 7 (stock/available s' 1 0)))))

(deftest take-from-at-last-usable-instant
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)
        [s' ok] (stock/take-from s 1 1 9)]
    (is (true? ok))
    (is (= 4 (get-in s' [:lots 1 :qty])))))

(deftest take-from-refuses-and-changes-nothing
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)
                     (lot 2 2 5 10 :quarantined)
                     (lot 3 1 0 10)
                     (lot 4 1 5 10)]
                    5)]
    (are [id n now] (= [s false] (stock/take-from s id n now))
      1  0  0    ;; n below 1
      1  6  0    ;; n above qty
      99 1  0    ;; no such lot
      2  1  0    ;; quarantined
      3  1  0    ;; empty lot
      4  1 10))) ;; expired exactly at now

;; --- purge -----------------------------------------------------------------

(deftest purge-removes-expired-lots-whatever-their-status
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)                 ;; expired at 10
                     (lot 2 1 5 5 :quarantined)     ;; expired, quarantined
                     (lot 3 1 5 20)                 ;; still good
                     (lot 4 1 0 5)]                 ;; expired and empty
                    5)
        p (stock/purge s 10)]
    (is (= [3] (sort (keys (:lots p)))))
    (is (= 5 (:next-id p)))
    (is (= (lot 3 1 5 20) (get-in p [:lots 3])))))

(deftest purge-expiry-boundary
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10) (lot 2 1 5 11)] 3)]
    (is (= [2] (sort (keys (:lots (stock/purge s 10))))) "expires <= now goes")
    (is (= [1 2] (sort (keys (:lots (stock/purge s 9))))) "expires > now stays")))

(deftest purge-empty-stock
  (is (= (stock-of [] 3) (stock/purge (stock-of [] 3) 0))))

(ns picking.core-test
  "Tests for picking.core: how a plan chooses and consumes lots, and what a
  pick reports."

            [picking.core :as picking]))

;; --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

(defn lot
  "A lot map, :active unless a status is given."
  ([id sku qty expires] (lot id sku qty expires :active))
  ([id sku qty expires status]
   {:id id :sku sku :qty qty :expires expires :status status}))

(defn stock-of
  "A stock map built from a collection of lots and a next id."
  [lots next-id]
  {:lots (into {} (map (fn [l] [(:id l) l]) lots))
   :next-id next-id})

;; --- plan ------------------------------------------------------------------

(deftest plan-of-nothing
  (testing "n 0 is the empty plan, even with no stock"
    (is (= [] (picking/plan (stock-of [] 0) 1 0 0))))
  (testing "n 0 is the empty plan, even with stock"
    (is (= [] (picking/plan (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2) 1 0 0)))))

(deftest plan-single-lot
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 10 10)] 2)]
    (testing "the last pick takes only what is needed"
      (is (= [[1 3]] (picking/plan s 1 3 0))))
    (testing "taking the whole lot is one full pick"
      (is (= [[1 10]] (picking/plan s 1 10 0))))
    (testing "more than the lot holds is nil"
      (is (nil? (picking/plan s 1 11 0))))))

(deftest plan-is-first-expiring-first
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 3 10)
                     (lot 2 1 5 20)] 3)]
    (testing "the earlier lot is used up before the later one is touched"
      (is (= [[1 3] [2 2]] (picking/plan s 1 5 0))))
    (testing "the entire later lot when needed"
      (is (= [[1 3] [2 5]] (picking/plan s 1 8 0))))
    (testing "only part of the later lot"
      (is (= [[1 3] [2 1]] (picking/plan s 1 4 0))))))

(deftest plan-orders-by-expiry-not-by-id
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 5 1 3 1)
                     (lot 2 1 3 3)] 6)]
    (is (= [[5 3] [2 3]] (picking/plan s 1 6 0)))))

(deftest plan-ties-break-on-lowest-id
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 9 1 2 5)
                     (lot 3 1 2 5)
                     (lot 7 1 2 5)] 10)]
    (is (= [[3 2] [7 2] [9 2]] (picking/plan s 1 6 0)))
    (is (= [[3 2] [7 2]] (picking/plan s 1 4 0)))))

  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 3 10)
                     (lot 2 1 5 20)] 3)]
    (is (= [[1 3] [2 2]] (picking/plan s 1 5 0)))
    (is (= [[1 3] [2 3]] (picking/plan s 1 6 0)))))

  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10 :quarantined)
                     (lot 2 1 5 5)      ;; expired at now 5
                     (lot 3 1 0 10)     ;; empty
                     (lot 4 1 5 20)]

    (is (= [[4 5]] (picking/plan s 1 5 5)))
    (is (nil? (picking/plan s 1 6 5)))))

    (is (= 2 (get-in s' [:lots 1 :qty])))))

    (is (not (contains? (:lots s') 1)) "the emptied lot is removed")
    (is (= 1 (get-in s' [:lots 2 :qty])))))

(deftest pick-zero-quantity-line-is-filled-with-no-picks
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)

    (is (= {:filled [0] :short [] :picks []} report))

  (let [s (stock-of [] 0)

    (is (= s s'))))

  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 5 10)] 2)
        [s' report] (picking/pick s [{:sku 1 :qty 3}
                                     {:sku 1 :qty 2}] 0)]
    (is (= {:filled [0 1]
            :short []
            :picks [[0 1 3] [1 1 2]]}
           report))
    (is (not (contains? (:lots s') 1)))))

(deftest pick-moves-to-the-next-lot-once-one-is-emptied
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 1 1 2 10)
                     (lot 2 1 5 20)] 3)
        [s' report] (picking/pick s [{:sku 1 :qty 2}
                                     {:sku 1 :qty 3}] 0)]
    (is (= {:filled [0 1]
            :short []
            :picks [[0 1 2] [1 2 3]]}
           report))
    (is (= (stock-of [(lot 2 1 2 20)] 3) s'))))

(deftest pick-mixed-order
  (let [s (stock-of [(lot 0 1 5 10)
                     (lot 1 1 10 20)
                     (lot 2 2 4 5)] 3)
        order [{:sku 1 :qty 6}
               {:sku 2 :qty 5}   ;; short: only 4 on hand, takes nothing
               {:sku 1 :qty 2}
               {:sku 99 :qty 1}] ;; short: no such sku
        [s' report] (picking/pick s order 0)]
    (is (= {:filled [0 2]
            :short [1 3]
            :picks [[0 0 5] [0 1 1] [2 1 2]]}
           report))
    (is (= (stock-of [(lot 1 1 7 20)
                      (lot 2 2 4 5)]
                     3)
           s'))))

(ns stock.core
  "Lots of goods with expiry dates. Time is a Nat tick passed in by the
  caller; lot ids, SKUs and quantities are Nats.")

(defn- usable?
  "A lot is usable at now when it is :active, holds at least 1, and has not
  reached its expiry (now < :expires)."
  [lot now]
  (and (= :active (:status lot))
       (<= 1 (:qty lot))
       (< now (:expires lot))))

(defn receive
  "Add an :active lot of qty of sku expiring at expires. Returns
  [stock' id] where id is the new lot's id. With qty 0 the stock is
  unchanged and the id is nil."
  [{:keys [next-id] :as stock} sku qty expires]
  (if (<= 1 qty)
    [(-> stock
         (assoc-in [:lots next-id]
                   {:id next-id :sku sku :qty qty
                    :expires expires :status :active})
         (update :next-id inc))
     next-id]
    [stock nil]))

(defn available
  "Total :qty of the usable lots of sku at now."
  [stock sku now]
  (reduce (fn [total lot]
            (if (and (= sku (:sku lot)) (usable? lot now))
              (+ total (:qty lot))
              total))
          0
          (vals (:lots stock))))

(defn quarantine
  "Make lot id :quarantined. With no such lot, nothing changes."
  [stock id]
  (if (contains? (:lots stock) id)
    (assoc-in stock [:lots id :status] :quarantined)
    stock))

(defn release
  "Make a :quarantined lot id :active again. Anything else changes nothing."
  [stock id]
  (if (= :quarantined (get-in stock [:lots id :status]))
    (assoc-in stock [:lots id :status] :active)
    stock))

(defn take-from
  "Take n from lot id at now. Returns [stock' ok?]. When lot id is usable
  at now and 1 <= n <= its :qty, the lot's :qty drops by n and ok? is true;
  a lot whose :qty reaches 0 is removed. Otherwise the stock is unchanged
  and ok? is false."
  [stock id n now]
  (let [lot (get-in stock [:lots id])]
    (if (and lot (usable? lot now) (<= 1 n) (<= n (:qty lot)))
      (let [qty (- (:qty lot) n)]
        [(if (zero? qty)
           (update stock :lots dissoc id)
           (assoc-in stock [:lots id :qty] qty))
         true])
      [stock false])))

  "Remove every lot that has expired (:expires <= now), whatever its status."
  [stock now]
  (update stock :lots
          (fn [lots]
            (into {}
                  (remove (fn [[_ lot]] (<= (:expires lot) now)))
                  lots))))

(ns picking.core
  "Fill orders from a stock.core stock. Time is a Nat tick passed in by the
  caller."
  (:require [stock.core :as stock]))

(defn- usable-lots
  "The usable lots of sku at now, first-expiring-first, ties on lowest id."
  [s sku now]
  (->> (vals (:lots s))
       (filter (fn [lot]
                 (and (= sku (:sku lot))
                      (= :active (:status lot))
                      (<= 1 (:qty lot))
                      (< now (:expires lot)))))
       (sort-by (juxt :expires :id))))

(defn plan
  "The picks that would take n of sku: a vector of [id k] pairs, each lot
  used up before the next is touched, the last pick taking only what is
  still needed. [] when n is 0; nil when the usable lots of sku hold less
  than n in all."
  [s sku n now]
  (loop [lots (usable-lots s sku now)
         need n
         picks []]
    (cond
      (zero? need) picks
      (empty? lots) nil
      :else
      (let [lot (first lots)
            k (min need (:qty lot))]
        (recur (rest lots) (- need k) (conj picks [(:id lot) k]))))))

(defn pick
  "Fill order, a vector of lines {:sku Nat :qty Nat}, in order, taking each
  line's plan through stock.core/take-from. A line whose plan is nil is
  short and takes nothing, and the next lines go on. Returns
  [stock' report] where report is
  {:filled [index ...] :short [index ...] :picks [[index id k] ...]}."
  [s order now]
  (loop [lines (seq order)
         idx 0
         s s
         filled []
         short []
         picks []]
    (if (empty? lines)
      [s {:filled filled :short short :picks picks}]
      (let [line (first lines)
            p (plan s (:sku line) (:qty line) now)]
        (if (nil? p)
          (recur (rest lines) (inc idx) s filled (conj short idx) picks)
          (let [[s' picks']
                (reduce (fn [[st ps] [id k]]
                          (let [[st' _ok] (stock/take-from st id k now)]
                            [st' (conj ps [idx id k])]))
                        [s picks]
                        p)]
            (recur (rest lines) (inc idx) s' (conj filled idx) short picks')))))))

# Notes

Two namespaces, written test-first. The tests were committed (`tests`,
`15e0b4e`) before any implementation existed, and `bin/test` was green on
the first implementation run: **no test had to be changed**. The final
implementation commit is `9448582`; `bin/test` runs 40 tests / 96
assertions, exit 0.

## What was hard to pin down in the tests

- **`nil` vs `[]` is the whole contract.** `plan` returns `[]` for `n = 0`
  and `nil` when the usable lots are short; a qty-0 order line is *filled*
  (because its plan is `[]`), while a line that wants more than is on hand
  is *short* and takes nothing. I test both sides of each: `plan` with
  `n = 0` on empty **and** non-empty stock, `plan` exactly short vs exactly
  enough, a qty-0 line against no stock at all, and a short line followed
  by lines that still get filled. An implementation that conflates the two
  fails immediately.

- **Dispatch that is not stated explicitly.** `TASK.md` describes
  `quarantine`/`release`/`purge` as *doing* something but never says they
  return the new stock, and never says `:next-id` is left alone by
  `take-from`/`quarantine`/`release`/`purge`. I inferred both from "the
  stock is unchanged" and from the `{:lots ... :next-id ...}` shape and
  pinned them, including the full `:next-id` in the expected map. If the
  intended contract allowed these to return something else, or to renumber
  ids, these tests would be wrong — but returning stale/unrenumbered state
  is the only reading consistent with the rest.

- **Ordering must be sorted, not incidental.** The map `{:lots {id lot}}`
  has no defined iteration order, so the tie-break test inserts ids in a
  deliberately non-ascending order and the first-expiring test inserts the
  earlier-expiring lot *after* the later one. A version that leans on map
  order rather than `(sort-by (juxt :expires :id) ...)` fails.

- **Exact report shape.** I assert the report with `=` against a literal
  three-key map (`:filled`, `:short`, `:picks`), so an implementation that
  returns those keys in a different container type, as seqs, in a different
  order, or with extra keys fails. `TASK.md` enumerates exactly three keys,
  so exactness is fair, but it is a choice: it forbids, e.g., a helpful
  extra `:total` field.

- **State threading through `pick`.** The tests only make sense if each
  line is planned against the stock *after* the previous lines ran: one
  test empties a lot in line 0 and requires line 1 to start from the next
  lot; another has a short line in the middle and requires the following
  line to be filled. Planning every line up front against the original
  stock passes a naive reading but fails these.

- **A short line is all-or-nothing.** "It is never partly filled" is easy
  to say and easy to get wrong (take whatever is there). A lot of qty 3 and
  a line of qty 5 lets the test check both that nothing was taken and that
  the stock value is untouched.

## What I could not express in tests

- **Non-`Nat` or malformed input.** `TASK.md` says ids, SKUs and quantities
  are Nats, so I test no negative quantities, non-integers, missing lot
  keys, or lots with `nil` `:expires`. There is no specified behavior to
  pin.

- **Mutation / aliasing.** The API is pure and the tests compare values.
  There is no way to observe from outside whether a call destructively
  modified the map it was handed; "the stock is unchanged" is asserted only
  as value equality.

- **The `take-from` failure path inside `pick`.** `pick` runs plans through
  `stock.core/take-from`, and the plan is *supposed* to guarantee each take
  succeeds. What should happen if it somehow did not (record a pick anyway?
  abort? mark the line short?) is unspecified, so I record the pick and
  ignore `ok?`; no test can reach that branch through the public API.

- **Bounded-ness / laziness / performance.** Nothing in the task constrains
  the size of a stock or order, so no such tests.

- **Whether extra report keys are tolerable.** I had to pick a side
  (forbidden, per the exact-match assertions); a looser reading of the
  report format is not testable without saying what extra keys mean.

- **Test syntax was checked off-repo.** Before committing, the tests were
  loaded against throwaway stubs in a copied tree under `/tmp` to confirm
  they compile and fail as expected, so the `tests` commit contains only
  test files. The real implementation was written only afterwards.
